verdicts.note: 補語位置の名詞的用法 to study。
want to do。
主語の名詞的用法 To get up。
形容詞的用法 homework to do。
目的を表す副詞的用法 to borrow。
感情の原因 happy to hear。
too ... to do。drink の目的語は主語と一致するので省略される定型。
old enough to do。
形式主語 It is important to do。
easy は性質形容詞でないので意味上の主語は for me。of は不可。
疑問詞+to不定詞 what to say。say の目的語が欠けるので what。
how to get to ... 行き方を表す。
tell+O+to do。
ask+O+to do。
grow up to do（結果の副詞的用法）。
like to do の名詞的用法。tokens に to/study 固定で動名詞別解は不可。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I have a book to read
verdicts.note: 形容詞的用法 a book to read。チャンク固定で語順は一意。

verdicts.produced_sentence: She was surprised to hear the news
verdicts.note: 感情の原因の副詞的用法。ただし tokens の she は小文字で、文頭で大文字 She にできないため厳密一致では she was surprised to hear the news となり文頭大文字化の不整合が残る。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I want to be a doctor
verdicts.note: want to be a doctor。チャンク固定で語順は一意。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This question is too difficult for me to solve
verdicts.note: too ... for ~ to do。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I didn't know what to do next
verdicts.note: 疑問詞+to不定詞 what to do next。

verdicts.produced_sentence: He is kind enough to help everyone.
verdicts.note: so kind that he can help → kind enough to help。

verdicts.produced_sentence: This box is too heavy for me to carry.
verdicts.multiple_valid_note: 意味上の主語を略した This box is too heavy to carry. も文法的に成立する。原文の I を反映するなら for me 付きがより忠実。
verdicts.note: so heavy that I cannot carry it → too heavy for me to carry。末尾の it は付けない。

verdicts.produced_sentence: It is interesting to learn a foreign language.
verdicts.note: 形式主語 It is ... to do。

verdicts.produced_sentence: I want something cold to drink.
verdicts.note: something+形容詞+to do の語順 something cold to drink。
